records.jp: あっ……
records.en_auxiliary: Ah...
records.en: Ah...

records.jp: ヒナちゃん大丈夫？
records.en_original: Are you okay, Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you okay, Hina?
records.en: Are you okay, Hina-chan?

records.jp: ありがとう。でも大丈夫
records.en_original: I'm...fine, thanks.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm...fine, thanks.
records.en: I'm...fine, thanks.

records.jp: ……鳴宮さん、ちょっといい、かな？
records.en_original: ...Hey, Narimiya, can we talk?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Hey, Narimiya, can we talk?
records.en: ...Narimiya-san, do you have a minute?

records.jp: 圭でいいよ
records.en_original: We can if you call me "Kei."
records.en_auxiliary: You can call me Kei.
records.en: Just call me Kei.

records.jp: うん。じゃあ、圭。……昨日は、ごめん
records.en_original: Um, sure, Kei... I want to apologize for yesterday.
records.en_auxiliary: Um, sure, Kei... I want to apologize for yesterday.
records.en: Okay. Then, Kei... Sorry about yesterday.

records.jp: ほい？
records.en_original: Oh?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh?
records.en: Hm?

records.jp: 個人的な問題なのに……気を遣ってくれたのに、<CR>八つ当たりしちゃって
records.en_original: I know you were just trying to look out for me, and I... I overreacted.
records.en_auxiliary: I know you were just trying to look out for me, and I... I overreacted.
records.en: It was a personal problem...and even though you were being considerate,<CR>I took it out on you.

records.jp: なんだ、そのことか！
records.en_original: Oh, that's what you're talking about. It's no big deal!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, that's what you're talking about. It's no big deal!
records.en: Oh, that?

records.jp: なんだって……あんなに当たり散らしたのに
records.en_original: But I was so mean to you...
records.en_auxiliary: But I was so mean to you...
records.en: How can you say that...? I lashed out at you so badly.

records.jp: あんなことでアタイは折れないって！
records.en_original: It takes more than a little yelling to shake me.
records.en_auxiliary: It takes more than a little yelling to shake me.
records.en: It takes more than a little yelling to shake me.

records.jp: それにね、白井が怒るのもわかるよ
records.en_original: And, honestly, I get where you were coming from.
records.en_auxiliary: And, honestly, I get where you were coming from.
records.en: And, honestly, I get where you were coming from.

records.jp: 人に言えない悩みを抱えている時に、<CR>あんなにしつこく迫られたら怒るよね
records.en_original: Everyone's got stuff they want to keep to themselves, and I just kept poking you about it. Of course you got mad.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone's got stuff they want to keep to themselves, and I just kept poking you about it. Of course you got mad.
records.en: You were carrying a problem you couldn't tell anyone about,<CR>and I kept pressing you. Of course you got angry.

records.jp: 友達にもまた注意されちゃった。あはは
records.en_original: My friends really gave me some grief for that one. Ahaha...
records.en_auxiliary: My friends really gave me some grief for that one. Ahaha...
records.en: My friends called me out on it again, too. Ahaha.

records.jp: だから白井の相談役はきっぱりと諦める！
records.en_original: So I've decided to stop trying to be your counselor.
records.en_auxiliary: So I've decided to stop trying to be your counselor.
records.en: So I've decided to stop trying to be your counselor.

records.jp: その代わりに白井。アタイと一緒にスポーツしよう！
records.en_original: Instead, you and me are gonna play some sports!
records.en_auxiliary: Instead, you and me are gonna play some sports!
records.en: Instead, Shirai, let's play some sports together!

records.jp: は！？　スポーツ！？<CR>なんでそうなるの？
records.en_original: Huh? Sports!? But why?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Sports?! But why?
records.en: Huh!? Sports!?<CR>How did this turn into sports?

records.jp: 思いっきり体を動かせば、<CR>たいていの悩みごとは吹き飛ぶからね！
records.en_original: Well, when you get your body moving, all of your worries kinda disappear!
records.en_auxiliary: Well, when you get your body moving, all of your worries kinda disappear!
records.en: When you really get your body moving,<CR>most worries just blow away!

records.jp: 相談役にはなれないけど、気持ちを楽にすることは<CR>アタイにだってできる！
records.en_original: Even if I'm not much of a counselor, I'm sure that I can help you work through some of your feelings!
records.en_auxiliary: Even if I'm not much of a counselor, I'm sure that I can help you work through some of your feelings!
records.en: I may not be able to advise you, but even I can help<CR>take your mind off things!

records.jp: 白井、あんまりスポーツ得意そうじゃないし、<CR>アタイがいろいろ教えてあげるよ！
records.en_original: I know you're no good at sports, Shirai, but that's where I come in! I'll get you totally up to speed!
records.en_auxiliary: I know you're no good at sports, Shirai, but that's where I come in! I'll get you totally up to speed!
records.en: You don't look like you're very good at sports, Shirai,<CR>so I'll teach you all kinds of things!

records.jp: ……私、これでも体の動きと体力には自信があるんだけど
records.en_original: ...I'm actually pretty athletic as-is.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm actually pretty athletic as is.
records.en: ...I happen to be confident in my coordination and stamina.

records.jp: えぇ？　そうは見えないけど？
records.en_original: Seriously!? You certainly don't look it!
records.en_auxiliary: Seriously?! You certainly don't look it!
records.en: Seriously!? You certainly don't look it!

records.jp: 鳴宮さん
records.en_original: Er, Narimiya...
records.en_auxiliary: Er, Narimiya...
records.en: Er, Narimiya-san...

records.jp: おっ、西田？　どうしたの？
records.en_original: Oh, hey, Nishida. What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, hey, Nishida. What's up?
records.en: Oh, hey, Nishida. What's up?

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃんは、今はちょっと休んでいるけど、<CR>子供の頃からずっとバレエをやっていたんだよ！
records.en_original: Well, you see, Hinako may be taking a break now, but she's done ballet since she was young.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, you see, Hinako may be taking a break now, but she's done ballet since she was young.
records.en: Hinako-chan may be taking a break right now,<CR>but she's been doing ballet since she was little!

records.jp: それはもう、すごかったんだから！
records.en_original: And she was absolutely incredible!
records.en_auxiliary: And she was absolutely incredible!
records.en: And she was absolutely incredible!

records.jp: ちょ、ちょっと早苗！<CR>そのことは――
records.en_original: S-Sanae! Don't tell her abo--
records.en_auxiliary: S-Sanae! Don't tell her abo—
records.en: W-Wait, Sanae!<CR>About that—

records.jp: へえ！　意外！　その身長で！<CR>ポジションどこ！？
records.en_original: Wow! Really?! But she's so short! Which position!?
records.en_auxiliary: Wow! Really?! But she's so short! Which position?!
records.en: Whoa! I didn't expect that! At your height!?<CR>What position did you play!?

records.jp: 身長……ポジション？
records.en_original: Short? ...Position?
records.en_auxiliary: Short? ...Position?
records.en: My height...? Position?

records.jp: バレーボールでしょ？
records.en_original: ...You did say volleyball, right?
records.en_auxiliary: ...You did say volleyball, right?
records.en: ...You did say volleyball, right?

records.jp: ば、バレエだよ！　踊るほう！
records.en_original: How did you get "volleyball" out of "ballet"? Don't you ever listen!? She's a dancer!
records.en_auxiliary: How did you get "volleyball" out of "ballet"? Were you not even listening? She's a dancer!
records.en: B-Ballet! The kind you dance!

records.jp: 更紗ちゃんの時、大騒ぎだったのに間違える？
records.en_original: How could she get that wrong after the big fuss with Sarasa?
records.en_auxiliary: How could she get that wrong after the big fuss with Sarasa?
records.en: How did she get that wrong after all the fuss about Sarasa-chan?

records.jp: その時、ちょうどけーちゃんいなかったような？
records.en_original: Actually, I don't think K was even here for that...
records.en_auxiliary: Actually, I don't think K was even here for that...
records.en: Actually, I don't think Kei-chan was even here for that...

records.jp: ……バカにしてるの？
records.en_original: ...Are you just making fun of me now?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Are you making fun of me?
records.en: ...Are you just making fun of me now?

records.jp: ごめんごめん、そんなつもりはなかったんだけど
records.en_original: No, I really didn't mean anything by it...
records.en_auxiliary: No, I really didn't mean anything by it...
records.en: No, I really didn't mean anything by it...

records.jp: でも白井の怒りもよくわかった
records.en_original: But now I see where all your anger is coming from.
records.en_auxiliary: But now I see where all your anger is coming from.
records.en: But now I understand why you got angry.

records.jp: よし、じゃあ、スポーツで勝負しよう！
records.en_original: Okay then, what do you say to a a little sports match!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay then, what do you say to a a little sports match!
records.en: All right, then let's settle this with a sports match!

records.jp: は！？　どうしてそうなるの？
records.en_original: Seriously? We're back to sports again?
records.en_auxiliary: Seriously? We're back to sports again?
records.en: Huh!? Why does it always come back to that?

records.jp: その人間がどれだけ努力してきたかなんてのは、<CR>体の動きを見たら、すぐにわかるからね
records.en_original: You can tell a lot about someone by the way they move their body! I think it'd help!
records.en_auxiliary: You can tell a lot about someone by the way they move their body!
records.en: You can tell how much effort someone has put in<CR>just by watching how they move.

records.jp: いいよ。そこまで言うなら勝負する
records.en_original: Fine then. If it's that important to you, I'll take you up on your challenge.
records.en_auxiliary: Fine then. If it's that important to you, I'll take you up on your challenge.
records.en: Fine then. If it's that important to you, I'll take you up on your challenge.

records.jp: せっかくだし、勝負に条件をつけよっか！<CR>そのほうが燃えるからね！
records.en_original: Ooh, and let's add some stakes to the match, too! That'll really get us fired up!
records.en_auxiliary: And since we're at it, let's add some stakes to the match, too! That'll really get us fired up!
records.en: Since we're doing this, let's put something at stake!<CR>That'll fire us up even more!

records.jp: 乗った。私が勝ったら……どうしよう
records.en_original: Sure. If I win... Hmm, I'm not really sure what I want.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure. If I win... Hmm, I'm not really sure what I want.
records.en: Sure. If I win... Hmm, I'm not really sure what I want.

records.jp: 今考えなくていいよ。なんでも一つ言うことを聞いてあげる
records.en_original: You don't need to make your decision now. If you win, I'll do whatever you say.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't need to make your decision now. If you win, I'll do whatever you say.
records.en: You don't need to make your decision now. If you win, I'll do whatever you say.

records.jp: 代わりにアタイが勝ったら、白井はもうちょっとクラスに<CR>溶け込む努力をしてもらうよ
records.en_original: But if I win, you've got to make a bit more of an effort to become part of the class.
records.en_auxiliary: But if I win, you've got to make a bit more of an effort to become part of the class.
records.en: In return, if I win, you'll have to make a little more effort<CR>to fit in with the class, Shirai.

records.jp: いいよ。絶対に負けないから
records.en_original: Alright. But there's no way I'm going to lose.
records.en_auxiliary: All right. But there's no way I'm going to lose.
records.en: Alright. But there's no way I'm going to lose.

records.jp: ふふふー、アタイだって本気で勝ちにいくからね！
records.en_original: Heh heh heh... Good. Cause I'm gonna come at you with everything I've got!
records.en_auxiliary: Heh heh heh... Good. Cause I'm gonna come at you with everything I've got!
records.en: Hehe! I'm going all out to win too!

records.jp: 勝負する競技は白井が決めていいよ。<CR>それくらいのハンデはないとね
records.en_original: I'm so confident, that I'll even let you decide what we'll compete in. Should give you a nice handicap.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so confident, that I'll even let you decide what we'll compete in. That should even the playing field.
records.en: You can choose the sport, Shirai.<CR>I've gotta give you at least that much of a handicap.

records.jp: その言葉、絶対に後悔させるから！
records.en_original: You're gonna regret that!
records.en_auxiliary: You're gonna regret that!
records.en: You're gonna regret that!

records.jp: ふふっ、ヒナちゃん楽しそうだね！
records.en_original: Hehe. It looks like Hina's really having fun!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. It looks like Hina's really having fun!
records.en: Hehe. It looks like Hina-chan's really having fun!

records.jp: ムキになってるだけのような気もするけど
records.en_original: Does it? To me, it looks like she's getting worked up.
records.en_auxiliary: Does it? To me, it looks like she's getting worked up.
records.en: Does it? To me, it looks like she's getting worked up.

records.jp: でも、考え込んで元気ないよりもずっといいよ！
records.en_original: Well, maybe a bit, but it sure beats having her down in the dumps!
records.en_auxiliary: But well, it sure beats having her down in the dumps!
records.en: Well, maybe a bit, but it sure beats having her down in the dumps!

records.jp: うん、そうだね
records.en_original: Yeah, you've got me there.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you've got me there.
records.en: Yeah, you've got me there.
